title: Tuple toolkit
hints: Tuples are objects with numeric keys and a literal `length` property — indexed access works on them: `T["length"]`, `T[0]`, and `T[number]` (every element).
Constrain all three with `T extends readonly unknown[]` so `readonly` tuples are accepted and strings are rejected. For `Last`, match a variadic pattern: `[...infer Rest, infer L]`.

type Length<T extends readonly unknown[]> = T["length"];  type TupleToUnion<T extends readonly unknown[]> = T[number];  type Last<T extends readonly unknown[]> = T extends readonly [...unknown[], infer L] ? L : never;
